title: 第24章班头第25章石魈遗毒
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
千重人影还叠在苏意的影子里。
他低头看着地上那片交叠的轮廓，然后抬头看向地宫四壁。
上千张浮雕面孔的眼眶已经空了，残魂抽离之后石雕只剩下石壳，但那些石壳的表情还在——有的张着嘴，有的皱着眉，有的嘴角往上扯，像在笑。
“历代掌门都在等这一刻。”
赵铁骨把白骨长棍往地上一顿，“等有个人带着所有人的苦，走进苦门。
门开了，该进去了。”
苏意没动。
“青石矿的事还没完。”
他转身往井道走，踏脚一圈一圈往上旋。
身后矿奴们默默跟上，火把的光在螺旋井道里拉成一条断断续续的链子。
回到矿场时天已经快亮了。
东边山头上镶了一层灰白色的光，矿场里的灵石灯盏全碎了，擂台上的青石板裂成两半，崖壁上钉着吴长老的尸体，高台柱子上还有宋岩留下的血迹。
矿奴们三三两两聚在矿场上，有人坐在地上打盹，有人围着何老闷问地宫里发生了什么，有人还抱着从矿道里抢出来的半袋矿石不舍得撒手。
苏意走到矿场中央那根铁柱前。
妖丹嵌在铁柱底座，土黄色的光泽缓缓流淌，矿脉核心的脉动已经平稳了。
赵独锋站在铁柱旁，双手拄着直刀，独眼半闭，听见脚步声睁眼。
“妖丹把矿脉稳住了。”
她说，“但不是永久——石魈七十年的修为最多撑三个月。
三个月后，丹力耗尽，矿脉还是会塌。
方圆三百里的所有矿道、矿坑、矿井，全部塌成天坑。”

苏意走到铁柱底座蹲下，手掌贴住妖丹。
妖丹里传来微弱的脉动——不是灵力，是石魈柳晴残留的一点本能。
这颗妖丹还在记着它的主人，但它的主人已经化成了碎石。
他站起来，转身面向矿场上所有人。
几百个矿奴，有的站在擂台上，有的坐在碎石堆上，有的靠在矿道口。
有男有女，有老有少，有断了手指的，有瘸了腿的，有瞎了一只眼的。
都是矿井里一起扛过石头的人。
“这颗矿脉下面有魂晶。”
苏意开口了，声音不大，但矿场上很安静，每个人都听得清，“比灵石更值钱。
青云宗灭了铁骨门满门就为抢它。
但挖魂晶要受罪——矿工会被残魂侵蚀，在幻境里一遍一遍重复死人受过的苦。”
有人吸了口凉气。
“还有一个选择。”
苏意指了指赵独锋，“跟她北上，去流放之地。
路上苦三个月，到了荒原还得从头开荒。
但至少是自己选的路。”
静了整整十息。
“留下来挖魂晶，青云宗来了你们扛不住，死路一条。”
苏意看着何老闷，看着田哑巴，看着陈瘸子、老周、小刘，看着擂台边还抱着矿石不放的那几个年轻矿奴，“我不替你们选。
柳晴替你们选了十年，吴长老替你们选了十年。
content_en:
Thousands of figures were still stacked in Su Yi's shadow.
He looked down at the overlapping outlines on the ground, then looked up at the four walls of the underground palace.
The eye sockets of thousands of relief faces have become empty. After the remaining souls are extracted, only the stone shells are left in the stone carvings, but the expressions of those stone shells are still there - some have their mouths open, some are frowning, and some have the corners of their mouths pulled upward, as if they are smiling.
"The leaders of all generations have been waiting for this moment."
Zhao Tiegu slapped the long bone stick on the ground, "Wait until someone takes everyone's suffering and walks into the door of suffering.
The door is open, it's time to go in. "
Su Yi didn't move.
"The bluestone mine is not over yet."
He turned around and walked toward the shaft, spinning his feet upwards in circles.
The mine slaves behind him followed silently, the light of the torches forming an intermittent chain in the spiral shaft.
It was almost dawn when we returned to the mine.
There was a layer of gray-white light on the top of the mountain to the east. The spiritual stone lamps in the mine were all broken. The bluestone on the platform was split in half. Elder Wu's body was nailed to the cliff. There were still blood stains left by Song Yan on the pillars of the high platform.
The mine slaves gathered in the mine in twos and threes. Some were sitting on the ground and taking a nap. Some were surrounding Mr. He and asking what happened in the underground palace. Some were still holding the half bag of ore they had snatched from the mine tunnel and were reluctant to let go.
Su Yi walked to the iron pillar in the center of the mine.
The demon pill is embedded in the base of the iron pillar, with an earthy yellow luster flowing slowly, and the pulsation of the core of the vein has stabilized.
Zhao Dufeng stood next to the iron pillar, holding a straight knife in both hands, with one eye half-closed. He opened it when he heard footsteps.
"The demon pill has stabilized the mineral vein."
She said, “But it’s not forever—Shi Mandrill’s seventy years of cultivation can only last three months at most.
After three months, the elixir power is exhausted and the veins will still collapse.
All mine tunnels, pits, and mines within a radius of three hundred miles collapsed into sinkholes. "
Su Yi walked to the base of the iron pillar and squatted down, placing his palm against the demon pill.
There was a weak pulse in the demon pill - not spiritual power, but the remaining instinct of Shidrill Liuqing.
This demon pill still remembers its owner, but its owner has turned into rubble.
He stood up and turned to face everyone in the mine.
There were hundreds of mining slaves, some standing on the ring, some sitting on the rubble, and some leaning against the mine entrance.
There were men and women, old and young, some with broken fingers, some with lame legs, and some with one eye blind.
They are all people who have carried stones together in the mine.
"There are soul crystals underneath this vein."
Su Yi spoke, not loudly, but the mine was very quiet and everyone could hear clearly, "More valuable than spiritual stones.
The Qingyun Sect destroyed the Iron Bone Sect and the entire clan was trying to grab it.
But digging for soul crystals involves suffering - the miners will be corroded by the residual souls and repeat the sufferings of the dead over and over again in the illusion. "
Someone took a breath.
"There is another option."
Su Yi pointed at Zhao Dufeng, "Follow her north to the place of exile.
It was a hard three months on the road, and when we got to the wasteland we had to clear the wasteland from scratch.
But at least it's the path you chose. "
It was quiet for ten breaths.
"Stay here to dig for soul crystals. If the Qingyun Sect comes and you can't handle it, you will die."
Su Yi looked at He Laomen, Tian Yaba, Chen Laizi, Lao Zhou, Xiao Liu, and the young mining slaves still holding the ore by the ring, "I won't choose for you.
Liu Qing chose ten years for you, and Elder Wu chose ten years for you.
